title: Where or how to build animations?
author: JapanEngineer
selftext: I am building a game. It needs 100 animations / sprite sheets for a character. I've tried 2 animation generators including ludo. Unfortunately I can't afford the costs of those online services and am wondering what other people are doing for generating many animations?

comments.author: Russmac316
comments.body:
For sprites, the pipeline isn't great yet. People are going to give you suggestions here but I'd honestly give it another 6 months to a year and work on other parts of the game because I'm sure these tools will improve.

It's not anywhere near the level of 3d yet.

comments.author: Reasonable_Damage_18
comments.body: I haven't found a better solution yet. For now, I'm just generating frame-by-frame animations.

replies.author: Reasonable_Damage_18
replies.body: Thanks! I'll give it a try.

comments.author: boxing-boxing
comments.body: I didn't use any sprite sheets or animation generators for my game,  just codex & claude to help with the artwork & animations. I am a software developer though.   Check it out for ideas [https://browserboxing.com](https://browserboxing.com)

replies.author: boxing-boxing
replies.body: Can preview a lot of the animations in the shop page (in game money only) [https://browserboxing.com/shop](https://browserboxing.com/shop)

comments.author: TopIntelligent8802
comments.body: I mean, you can use claude to match the animation frame by frame. Is it slow and expensive? yeah. But I don't understand why people think "unfortu ately I cannot afford" is any kind of excuse. To me that sounds like "hey guys, os I am making GTA VII but unfortunately I cannot afford 1000 employees on 3 continents, what is the alternative?" You just don't make that game then and make something you can do or afford

replies.author: JapanEngineer
replies.body: That's great advice and what I am looking for. Your delivery is appalling though, very condescending.

comments.author: Masterkiefs
comments.body: Ask Claude to build story boards to help understand animations better.  What’s your engine?

replies.author: JapanEngineer
replies.body: Just started testing with various models on Ollama. My GPU isn't the best.

replies.author: Masterkiefs
replies.body: If you can run opus 5.5 via cloud you can build the storyboarding from there to help with animations. It can also code your sprite

comments.author: RsetX
comments.body: Hello! I made a tool that run locally on your consumer GPU (8 GB VRAM minimum), using ref2v and i2v models as Minimax H3 and Wan 2.2, you can download it here: https://shaddafare.itch.io/sprite-sheep
